description: Land Acquisition - Barandara, Thumpane D/S Division, Kandy District (Order No. 84 of 2023)
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order directing the acquisition of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, their boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a minister's name (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content focuses on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification priority rules.
